pins.head: BINS FIT THE TV CONSOLE
pins.title: Small Apartment: Fabric Bins Turn an Open TV Console Into Storage
pins.desc: An open TV console collects cables, remotes and chargers in plain sight. Fabric bins sized to the cubbies hide all of it, pull out like drawers and cost far less than a new cabinet. Measure one cubby before you buy so the bins sit flush. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #LivingRoomStorage #BudgetDecor
pins.alt: A white TV console with fabric bins in its open cubbies under a flat-screen TV, beside a ladder shelf with books and woven bins and the arm of a grey sofa.

pins.head: A RULER SHOWS THE REAL SIZE
pins.title: Acne Patches: Lay a Ruler on the Sheet Before Comparing Packs
pins.desc: Pack photos make every patch look the same size. Lay a ruler across the sheet and the gap between the small and the large patches is obvious, along with how many of each size you actually get. Compare the count of the size you use, not the total. Contains affiliate links. #AcnePatches #SkincareBasics #CompareBeforeYouBuy
pins.alt: Sheets of round clear hydrocolloid patches in several sizes with a clear ruler laid across them on a white bathroom counter above a light wood drawer.

pins.head: THE CART HOLDS THE DAILY KIT
pins.title: Small Bathroom: Keep the Everyday Kit on a Rolling Cart, Not the Counter
pins.desc: The things you use every morning crowd the sink because there is nowhere else to put them. A slim rolling cart beside the vanity takes them off the counter, keeps them in reach, and rolls out of the way when you clean, all without a single hole in the wall. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #RollingCart #NoDrill
pins.alt: A wooden vanity with a sink, soap bottles and a potted plant, a slim white rolling cart beside it and a toilet under a shelf of baskets and towels in a bright bathroom.

pins.head: STACK THE MATS FLAT
pins.sub: Store Them Like Paper, Not Rolls
pins.title: Cutting Mats: Store Them Flat in a Stack to Keep Them Cutting Straight
pins.desc: A cutting mat that curls in storage feeds crooked and cuts off-line. Stack them flat with the protective sheet on, the lightest grip on top, and they stay true. A brayer and a scraper kept on the stack mean the next project starts on a clean mat. Contains affiliate links. #CricutTips #CuttingMat #CraftRoomOrganization
pins.alt: A flat stack of green, blue and purple cutting mats on a wooden table with a roller brayer and a cream scraper on top and small cut vinyl pieces around.

pins.head: LOW HEAT FOR FOAM AND FABRIC
pins.title: Dual-Temperature Hot Glue Gun for Foam, Fabric and Wood
pins.desc: High heat melts foam and scorches thin fabric. A glue gun with a low setting handles those, then switches to high for wood and card that need a stronger bond. One gun with two temperatures covers most craft jobs. Rest it on its stand between uses. Contains affiliate links. #HotGlueGun #CraftSupplies #DIYCrafts
pins.alt: A cream hot glue gun resting on a wooden stand with glue sticks beside it, a squeeze bottle of craft glue and a roll of masking tape on a wooden workbench.

pins.head: THE BASKET TAKES TODAY'S PILE
pins.sub: Clear Desk by the End of Day
pins.title: Small Home Office: A Basket Under the Desk Clears the Top Every Evening
pins.desc: Paper you are still working on does not belong in a file yet, and it should not live on the desk either. A basket under the desk takes today's pile at the end of the day, so the surface starts clear tomorrow and nothing gets lost in a drawer. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskOrganization #WorkFromHome
pins.alt: A light wood desk with a file sorter, a small drawer box of pens and a laptop on a wooden stand, with a woven basket on the floor under the desk.

pins.head: KEEP THE WATER JAR CLOSE
pins.sub: Jar, Brushes and Palette in Reach
pins.title: Miniature Painting: Keep the Rinse Jar and Wet Palette Within Reach
pins.desc: Reaching across the desk for water is how a loaded brush drips on a finished figure. Set the rinse jar, the cup of brushes and the wet palette in a tight group beside the figure you are painting, and every dip and wipe is a short, steady move. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #PaintingTips #Wargaming
pins.alt: A cup of paint brushes and a glass jar of rinse water beside a wet palette with paint on a green cutting mat, with a grey spray can and a primed figure on a cork at the edge.

pins.head: SHIRTS UP, TROUSERS BELOW
pins.title: Tiny Closet: Hang Shirts on the Top Rail and Trousers on the Bottom
pins.desc: Shirts and folded trousers are both short, so one rail wastes half the closet height. A second rail underneath splits them by length, shirts above and trousers below, and the same closet holds twice as much without a single new hole in the wall. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #SmallCloset #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: An open closet with shirts hung on an upper rail and trousers on a lower rail, woven baskets on the top shelf and clear shoe boxes on the floor.

pins.head: BRUSH HEADS NEXT TO THE TUBES
pins.sub: One Drawer for All the Spares
pins.title: Toothpaste and Brush Heads: Keep the Spares Together in One Drawer
pins.desc: Spare toothpaste and spare brush heads run out on different schedules, so one always surprises you. Keep both in the same drawer divider, tubes standing and heads in a row, and one glance tells you which to reorder before the last one is in use. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomOrganization #RefillPlanning #DrawerOrganization
pins.alt: An open bathroom drawer with clear dividers holding white toothpaste tubes standing upright and a row of spare electric toothbrush heads.

pins.head: PLANTS CLIMB A TENSION POLE
pins.title: Renter Storage: A Tension-Pole Shelf Holds Plants by the Window
pins.desc: A tension pole wedges between floor and ceiling and holds small shelves without a single screw. Beside a window it turns dead wall into a plant stand, and when you move it comes down in minutes and leaves no marks on either surface. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #PlantShelf #NoDrillStorage
pins.alt: A white floor-to-ceiling pole shelf of potted plants beside a window, a grey sofa with cushions and an ottoman, and a pocket organizer hanging on an open door.

pins.head: ONE BAG, ONE CALENDAR MONTH
pins.title: Medium Roast Whole Bean Coffee, 30 oz, Sized for a Monthly Order
pins.desc: A 30 oz bag of whole beans lasts a two-cup household about a month, which is also about how long beans stay at their best once opened. Set the subscription to that and mark the delivery on the calendar so the next bag lands before the last scoop. Contains affiliate links. #CoffeeSubscription #WholeBeanCoffee #PantryPlanning
pins.alt: Two plain kraft coffee bags beside a small blank desk calendar, a mug and scattered coffee beans on a light wood counter.

pins.head: TAPE THE CABINET BEFORE BINS
pins.sub: Height, Depth and the Door Hinge
pins.title: Kitchen Bins: Measure the Cabinet Height and Depth Before You Buy
pins.desc: Bins are sold by width, but cabinets are ruled by height and by the hinge that juts into the opening. Run a tape across each shelf, note the clearance under the one above and the depth past the hinge, and stackable drawers will slide in on the first try. Contains affiliate links. #KitchenOrganization #CabinetStorage #MeasureTwice
pins.alt: An open cream kitchen cabinet with clear stackable drawers of spices and measuring spoons, a utensil cup on the upper shelf and a yellow tape measure on the lower shelf.
